Eastern nations are noted for their superstitions and in palestine the natives wear charms to ward off the "evil eye". The charm mostly adopted is a row of blue beads so made as to resemble an eye. They serve a double purpose, as an ornament and as affording protection against evil spirits. Other charms are made of tin and wood upon which is engraved words from the Koran. They are principally worn by women and young girls.
